main_body: A church pew seen from the east/west side: a tall narrow wooden backrest on the left and a seat section with a red cushion panel on the right, the seat running vertically along the picture.
top_band: none; the backrest top is a 1-2 px dark brown cap at rows 8-9 and the seat has only a thin lighter tan strip at rows 14-15 (about 2 px). No horizontal surface reads as a top.
evidence: The pew is drawn as a side profile. The backrest is a tall vertical strip on the left and the seat is a vertical column of red cushion panels, with only a 2 px tan rim at the top (rows 14-15) and thin tan bands between the cushions. The seat surface is never visible from above. The bottom has a thin tan base and a black strip. This matches the guide's red 'side elevation chair' and 'rim only' cases, not a 3/4 object with a top band of several rows.

style.evidence: The outline is dark brown beside the wood, which fits the standard. The wood has only about 3 tones (tan, mid brown, dark brown). The red cushions are large flat fills of 2-3 reds with no grain, speckle or per-element highlights. The backrest strip is a nearly uniform tan with no grain. Tiles carry only 2-4 colours, far below the stall and well references, which have tile scallops, grain and stone shading.
